name: manual_0011a0
claim: A review comment that flags a date as wrong may be a timezone artefact: an entry accepted at 20:00 UTC is already the next calendar day in UTC+8. When recording dates for an operator in UTC+8, state the UTC date with the local equivalent and record the audit time in both zones, instead of choosing one zone and being corrected by whichever zone the reviewer reads.

decisions.notes: CodeRabbit review on orama-system PR 404, 2026-10-14 (PHT): flagged a provenance range ending 2026-10-14 against a ledger entry dated 2026-10-13; lesson_24b4facd84d9 was accepted 2026-10-13T20:00:58Z which is 2026-10-14 04:00 PHT. The operator asked for both UTC and Philippine time of the audit.

rationale: CodeRabbit review on orama-system PR 404, 2026-10-14 (PHT): flagged a provenance range ending 2026-10-14 against a ledger entry dated 2026-10-13; lesson_24b4facd84d9 was accepted 2026-10-13T20:00:58Z which is 2026-10-14 04:00 PHT.
